Elegant thick rounded rectangle with clipped beveled corners, warm dark wood outer rim, polished hand-painted gold/brass inner trim, cream highlight, subtle sculpted cartoon depth, premium friendly fantasy mobile game exactly matching reference. Simple symmetric frame with clear straight stretchable center edges suitable Unity9-slicing; small understated corner rivets. Center opening covers roughly84%width and88%height, genuinely empty alpha. ALL interior, including lowerpart, transparent. Soft gently shaded turquoise-blue center, darker deepteal outercorners, a few simplified blurred painted leafsilhouettes nearleft/rightedges, extremely subtle tiny golden motes atouteredgeonly.
